description: List anime/manga AniList users recommend as similar to a given title, ranked by rating (highest first). Use search_media first to resolve the title to its AniList ID. Each result's `mediaRecommendation.mediaListEntry` (requires login) shows whether it's already on your own list — set `excludeInList: true` to drop those from the fetched page instead of checking each one yourself (a local post-fetch filter: AniList's own `onList` filter applies to the source title, not the recommended one).

excludeInList.description: [Requires login] Omit recommendations already on your own list. Filtered after fetching this page, so a page can come back with fewer than `perPage` results — not an error, just fewer new ones on that page. Errors if not logged in, since there's no list to check against.

mediaId.description: AniList ID of the anime/manga to get recommendations for.

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 25, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

name: get_recommendations_for_media

averageScore.description: The weighted community rating across all AniList users, on AniList's 0-100 community scale. It stays 0-100 whatever the viewer's configured scoreFormat is, since that setting only changes how anilist.co displays scores. This is NOT the 0-10 scale a personal list-entry `score` uses.

mediaListEntry.description: Whether this recommended title is on the caller's own list — viewer-relative, so it only resolves when logged in; null both when logged out and when the title just isn't on the list (the two cases aren't distinguishable from this field alone).

rating.description: Net rating (RATE_UP minus RATE_DOWN votes across all users), not the caller's own.

pageInfo.description: Whether another page exists — use this to decide whether to paginate.

title: Get recommendations for a title
